title.narrative: Building capacity to deliver maternal and child health in Africa

description.narrative: Women and Children First (UK) addresses unacceptably high levels of maternal and newborn mortality and morbidity in poor communities in the developing world. We work in partnership with NGOs, governments and academic institutions to promote innovative, low cost solutions to reduce maternal and newborn mortality and increase wellbeing for women, girls and newborns. We identify best practice through extensive monitoring and evaluation and disseminate lessons learned to health officials, policymakers etc. We have worked in Bangladesh, India, Malawi and Nepal, are planning work in Ethiopia and considering additional countries in Africa. Our Strategic Framework for 2012-2016 will be agreed in late 2011 and will focus on deepening work in Africa. To inform this we need detailed needs assessments of potential programme countries to identify where we can best add value. To respond effectively to the identified need and deliver on our strategy, we will need to build our own capacity to: establish effective new partnerships, including identifying and meeting partners' capacity building needs; secure programme funding; and develop systems to manage a greater number of grants efficiently. The impact will be a greater reach for programmes applying a method which has been scientifically proved to deliver lasting change.
